newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open steady-to-firm.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open steady-to-firm.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open steady-to-firm Monday, in line with LME copper prices.
COMEX September was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Friday's close at 106.10 cents, after trading a 106.30-106.00 cent range in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME warehouse copper stocks rose a further 1,700 tonnes Monday 250,400 tonnes, the highest level Septemner last year.
COMEX copper stocks rose 442 short tons Friday to 32,876 short tons.
The LME cash-to-three month spread remained flat around $28.00 a tonne.
Copper prices have been consolidating in the past few weeks, after a slide from 12 month highs a month ago.
